The truth: isolated stickhandling doesn’t transfer to games. You might develop quick hands. You might look smooth in drills. But without integrating footwork, balance, posture, and skating mechanics, you’ll be missing that puck on a string look in-game.

We’ve all seen players with “great hands” who somehow struggle in games. That disconnect happens when puck skills are trained without mechanical awareness or integration. Repeating the same patterns around cones without adjusting mechanics can actually reinforce bad habits instead of building elite control.

Our goal with this system is to give you a language for puck control: a mechanical framework you can understand, feel, and adjust. When you combine awareness with deliberate repetition, you build mastery.

Inside this course, you’ll learn:

1) How elite NHL players integrate skating, handling, and deception.

2) What mechanical adjustments create real control at top speed.

3) How to systematically close the gaps in your own puck control.

4) How to create more options in more situations during games.

👉  Drills, breakdowns, progressions, and full mechanics playbook (100’s of videos) all available in Train 2.0+.

Gemini 4 Explained: Google’s 2 Trillion Parameter AI https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Google’s Gemini 4 could become one of the most important AI models of 2026 — but how much of what we’re hearing about it is actually true?

In this video, we investigate the story behind Gemini 4, the delayed Gemini 3.5 Pro, Google’s reported struggles with coding and agentic coding, and the viral claim that Gemini 4 could have 2 trillion parameters.

Google originally said Gemini 3.5 Pro was coming in June. That deadline passed, and reports from Bloomberg and Reuters later pointed to concerns around coding performance and competition from OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI labs. Sundar Pichai subsequently acknowledged areas where Gemini needed to improve, including coding and agentic coding, while describing Gemini 4 as a larger base model Google needs to compete at the AI frontier.

But is Gemini 4 really a 2 trillion parameter AI model? And was it accelerated because Gemini 3.5 Pro failed to meet expectations?

We separate what Google has actually confirmed from rumors and speculation, examine the competitive pressure surrounding Gemini, and break down what Gemini 4 could mean for the next stage of the AI race.

If calcium is present, improving your diet, especially by lowering refined carbohydrates, and supporting healthy calcium metabolism with vitamin K2 and vitamin D3 may help support cardiovascular health.

videos.title: Golf Swing Too Steep? Try This Wall Drill
videos.summary_source_text:
Golf Swing Too Steep? Try This Wall Drill If your golf swing is too steep, this wall drill can help you understand what needs to change. ⛳️

A lot of golfers try to fix a steep downswing by forcing the club to shallow on the way down.

But the problem can start much earlier.

Watch what happens in this drill.

If the club works too steep, the wall gives you immediate feedback. Instead, work on allowing the club, wrists, and elbows to move more behind you as your body turns into the backswing.

From there, you have a much better opportunity to rotate through and get the club working from the inside instead of coming down steep.

That’s what makes this drill so useful.

You’re not staring at a swing video trying to decide if your golf swing plane looks right.

You have a physical boundary that tells you right away.

Too steep? You know it.
Better path? You feel it.

And that same idea is why I like practicing with the Blue Brick.

The Blue Brick uses alignment sticks as a physical reference for your swing, giving you feedback while you’re actually making the movement.

So instead of telling yourself:
“Shallow the club.”
“Swing from the inside.”
“Stop coming over the top.”

You have something in front of you that helps you train the path.
If this wall drill makes sense to you, the Blue Brick gives you a way to bring that type of feedback to your practice sessions.

Watch the reel again and pay attention to where the club is at the top, then where it starts working as the body rotates.

videos.title: 479. Hur mycket sparar svensken 2026? | Jämför ditt månadssparande
videos.summary_source_text:
479. Hur mycket sparar svensken 2026? | Jämför ditt månadssparande • • Vad sparar svensken egentligen, och hur ligger du till jämfört med snittet? Den officiella sparkvoten på 13,5 % låter bra, men den räknar in tjänste- och premiepensionen. Ditt eget, fria sparande är troligen närmare 5,9 % av din disponibla inkomst, cirka 2 000 kronor i månaden.

I det här avsnittet går vi igenom siffror från SCB, SEB, SBAB, Nordea, Avanza och Lysa, plus nästan 10 000 svar från RikaTillsammans-communityn, där medianen ligger på 8 100 kronor i månaden, nästan fyra gånger snittet. Vi tittar också på spargapet mellan män och kvinnor, som räknat över tid kan handla om miljoner kronor, och landar i att ett sparande faktiskt är en uppoffring du gärna får ge dig själv en klapp på axeln för.

Några av ämnena vi tar upp i veckans avsnitt är:

• Sparkvoten på 13,5 % är en synvilla – det egna sparandet ligger på 5,9 %
• Vad svensken faktiskt sparar till: pension, buffert och bostad
• Så mycket sparar folk enligt SCB, SEB, SBAB, Nordea och Avanza
• Spargapet: män sparar 28 % mer än kvinnor i månaden
• Vad spargapet kan kosta över tid, räknat från 18 till 69 års ålder
• Lysas jämnare sparande jämfört med Avanzas
• RikaTillsammans-communityns sparande: median 8 100 kronor i månaden
• Sparkvot per inkomstdecil och var du ligger på Rikedomstrappan
• KPL, koll på läget, och varför du får unna dig att pausa sparandet ibland

Vi hoppas att du gillar avsnittet,
Jan, Caroline och Oliver

24.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Denna gång är det Challe Berglund som sitter ner med Leksands unge center August Lissel.

August Lissel är tillsammans med Zaki Crookes två spelare födda 2006 som imponerade under turneringen i Strömstad och ger Leksandsfansen hopp om ett stort genombrott. 

De var båda några av utropstecknen under veckan på Västkusten – och mellan matcherna satte sig Challe Berglund ner med Lissel och benade ut centerns egenskaper, varför genombrottet inte kommit tidigare, och vad 20-åringen behöver jobba på.

videos.title: Tingling or Numb Feet? You May Be Missing This
videos.summary_source_text:
Tingling or Numb Feet? You May Be Missing This Benfotiamine is a fat-soluble form of vitamin B1 that is especially useful for nerve health and problems related to high blood sugar. Vitamin B1 is needed by enzymes in the mitochondria that help your cells produce energy. The more glucose you have circulating in the blood, the more vitamin B1 your body requires.

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4hINjIs

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Benfotiamine can be especially helpful for:
• Tingling, numbness, or burning in the feet and hands
• Decreasing peripheral neuropathy
• Supporting healthy nerve function
• Reducing the formation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs)
• Protecting proteins and mitochondria from glycation damage

High blood sugar can increase glycation and contribute to many of the complications associated with diabetes. Benfotiamine helps slow that process while supporting healthy vitamin B1 levels and nerve function.

Räknar man bort pensionssparandet landar den verkliga sparkvoten på bara 5–6 %, vilket motsvarar ungefär 2 000 kr i månaden för någon som tjänar medianlönen 38 300 kr eller snittlönen 42 900 kr.

Som jämförelse låg mediansparandet i RT:s egen community på nästan 8 000 kr i månaden — fyra gånger så mycket.

videos.title: 5 Bodyweight Exercises That Fix 95% Of Your Problems
videos.summary_source_text:
5 Bodyweight Exercises That Fix 95% Of Your Problems 22 Days to More Pullups - https://athleanx.com/morepullups
Subscribe to this channel here - http://bit.ly/2b0coMW

If you are looking for 5 exercises that fix 95% of your problems, then you’ve come to the right place. In this video, I am going to show you 5 different exercises that will help to deal with the common problem areas in the body as well as working on those stiff and achey joints so you can feel loose and pain free throughout the day.

The first exercise up a pushup variation done to target very specific problem areas. If you have bad posture, rounded, tight, achey shoulders and low back problems, this hand-release superman pushup will address those areas immediately. By extending the arms straight out in front, you are promoting overhead shoulder biomechanics and thoracic extension. When it comes to bad posture, we often have trouble getting our arms overhead, especially due to rounding of the thoracic spine. If we can get thoracic extension, we can promote good posture. It's important to note that we often neglect the muscles on the backside of our body, which leads to weakness which then leads to poor posture and biomechanics.

videos.title: The REAL Difference Between A Pro And A 10 Handicap
videos.summary_source_text:
The REAL Difference Between A Pro And A 10 Handicap Where do amateur golfers actually lose the shots that stop them shooting lower scores? In this pro vs amateur golf match, Mark Crossfield plays against a 10 handicapper (with a twist) to find out how the best golfers lower their scores and where higher handicap golfers really lose shots.

In this golf match, we're testing driving vs approach play in a completely different way.

Mark and a 10 handicap golfer play a match, but after every tee shot, they swap balls. Mark has to finish each hole from the amateur golfer's drive, while the 10 handicapper gets to play from Mark's tee shot.

Can playing from a pro's tee shots help an amateur golfer shoot lower scores, and will Mark be able to recover from having to play a 10 handicapper's drives?

The result might surprise you.

This experiment provides a fascinating look at strokes gained golf, golf course management, penalty shots off the tee and where golfers really gain and lose shots during a round.

While amateur golfers can lose huge chunks of their score through penalty shots and costly mistakes, better players are constantly making smaller gains across every area of their game: approach play, short game, putting, decision-making and avoiding unnecessary penalty shots.

It's a great example of why Mark Broadie's Every Shot Counts is such a useful way of understanding golf strokes gained — small advantages across every part of the game quickly add up.

If you're trying to understand how to lower your golf scores, improve your golf course management or simply work out where you're really losing shots, this match gives you a practical look at how strokes gained plays out on the golf course rather than just on a spreadsheet.

Watch the match, see who comes out on top, and let us know in the comments: if you could have a pro golfer hit one type of shot for you all round, which would you choose?

videos.summary_source_text:
This AI Creates Insane 3D Worlds This might be one of the coolest AI models I’ve seen all year.

Tencent’s new WorldClaw model can generate an entire editable 3D world from a prompt — not just the environment, but every individual object inside it.

Trees, buildings, carts, lamp posts, terrain, they’re all generated as separate 3D assets you can actually work with.

Under the hood, it combines image generation, segmentation, and Tencent’s Hunyuan 2D-to-3D tech to turn a generated scene into a full collection of 3D objects.

And the use cases could get really interesting.

You could imagine generating game environments in minutes, building virtual worlds for simulations, or even creating environments where robots can train before they ever enter the real world.

Unfortunately we can’t actually play with this model yet, but this is absolutely one I’m keeping an eye on.

videos.title: New Audi RS5: has Audi ruined it?
videos.summary_source_text:
New Audi RS5: has Audi ruined it? The all-new Audi RS5 has one BIG secret - and it might not be a good thing!

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Audi RS5! 

While it’s clear to see that this new generation RS has had a makeover from the outside, it’s hiding a secret that you can’t see from the design alone. It’s now a plug-in hybrid, and as a result, the weight has shot up to over 2,300kg! 

In comparison, the BMW M3 that we’ve brought along for this review tips the scales at only 1,790kg - so the RS5 is more than half a tonne heavier! The question is, does the weight really make such a big difference? Let’s take a closer look. 

Even if you’re not a fan of hybrid tech, there’s no denying that the new RS5 looks seriously impressive! Up from there’s a huge, aggressive-looking wide grille, and a whole load of vents that all serve a purpose. Along the side the widened wheel arches give the car more presence on the road, as do the side skirts. Along the back, the design is relatively similar to the standard A5, although there’s a small boot lip spoiler, coupled with a new lower bumper with a big diffuser and two massive exhausts. 

On the inside, the layout is relatively similar to the standard A5 & S5, although there are a few differences. There’s an octagonal sports steering wheel, which comes with both ‘RS’ and ‘Boost’ buttons to easily configure the driving mode. There are RS sports seats with red stitching, RS badging on the kick plates, and Alcantara-type material across the dash. The digital dial screen also comes with bespoke RS dials. Otherwise, the layout is pretty much the same as the standard car, with a large curved dial & infotainment screen, as well as a screen for the passenger.

The new Audi RS5 is powered by a 2.9-litre twin-turbo V6, coupled with an electric motor. Combined, the new RS5 puts down 639hp and 825Nm. This power is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic gearbox. 

The new Audi RS5 costs from £89,400, which is around £2,000 less than a BMW M3, which is a couple of years older. What’s more, the cost of the RS5 we’re reviewing, with added options, is around £97,000, while the M3 is loaded with kit and costs approximately £118,000! But is the non-hybrid M3 a better option than the surprisingly heavy RS5? Join Mat for this all-new review, and then let us know which you’d choose in the comments!

videos.title: Do the Avalanche Have More Pressure to Win Than Any Other Team?
videos.summary_source_text:
Do the Avalanche Have More Pressure to Win Than Any Other Team? Colorado Avalanche enter the season with sky-high expectations—are Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar under more pressure to deliver another Stanley Cup than Connor McDavid’s Edmonton Oilers? The conversation compares pressure rankings across NHL contenders, explores the Avs’ recent playoff shortcomings, and debates why teams like the Panthers, Hurricanes, and Stars sit just behind Colorado when it comes to title urgency.

The discussion highlights how pressure varies for rebuilding franchises like the San Jose Sharks and Chicago Blackhawks, with different benchmarks for success. Jersey fanatics get the scoop on the upcoming Hometown Remix uniforms and the potential return of the iconic Yeti foot for the Avs’ outdoor clash with the Utah Mammoth. Plus, the hosts break down EA NHL 27 player ratings—questioning whether MacKinnon and Makar are getting the elite recognition they deserve. Will the Avalanche rise to the challenge, or will another contender seize the moment?

Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images

videos.title: Your Golf Swing Starts From the Ground Up
videos.summary_source_text:
Your Golf Swing Starts From the Ground Up If you’re struggling with inconsistent ball striking, chunks, thin shots, or a golf swing that feels all arms, look down before you start changing what your hands are doing. 👀⛳️

Your pressure shift might be the missing piece.
Watch the feet and hips closely in this video, because the important part isn’t just where your weight goes, it’s when it gets there.

In the backswing, pressure loads into the trail side, staying more toward the inside of the trail foot rather than drifting to the outside.

But here’s the part a lot of golfers miss:
You don’t wait until the backswing is finished to start moving toward the target.
As the club is finishing the backswing, pressure is already beginning to move toward the lead side.

That gives you a better opportunity to rotate through the shot instead of:
→ Hanging back on your trail foot
→ Sliding through impact
→ Throwing the arms at the ball
→ Trying to save the strike at the last second

Think of the sequence as:
LOAD → SHIFT → ROTATE

Not:
LOAD → WAIT → PANIC. 😅

And this is why simply watching weight-shift videos can only get you so far.
You may understand exactly what you’re supposed to do and still have no idea whether you’re actually doing it.

That’s the problem the Ball First Board is designed to solve.

It gives you physical feedback for the trail-side load, helps prevent excessive sway, and gives you a reference for moving into the lead side so you can train the movement you’re seeing in this video instead of guessing.

If you’re tired of knowing what a good golf swing should look like but struggling to reproduce the feeling, this is where I’d start.

videos.title: The Untaught Stickhandling Mechanics You Need To Know
videos.summary_source_text:
The Untaught Stickhandling Mechanics You Need To Know Welcome to Precise Puck Control.

There’s a reason we call this puck control and not just stickhandling.

Stickhandling usually refers to isolated mechanics like moving the puck around cones or in drills disconnected and from real gameplay. Puck control, in our context, is different. It’s the conscious ability to move the puck exactly where you want, at the speed you want, while your skating, shooting, and deception mechanics are fully integrated.

At Train 2.0, we teach it as part of a complete movement system.

The truth: isolated stickhandling doesn’t transfer to games. You might develop quick hands. You might look smooth in drills. But without integrating footwork, balance, posture, and skating mechanics, you’ll be missing that puck on a string look in-game.

We’ve all seen players with “great hands” who somehow struggle in games. That disconnect happens when puck skills are trained without mechanical awareness or integration. Repeating the same patterns around cones without adjusting mechanics can actually reinforce bad habits instead of building elite control.

Our goal with this system is to give you a language for puck control: a mechanical framework you can understand, feel, and adjust. When you combine awareness with deliberate repetition, you build mastery.

Inside this course, you’ll learn:

1) How elite NHL players integrate skating, handling, and deception.

2) What mechanical adjustments create real control at top speed.

3) How to systematically close the gaps in your own puck control.

4) How to create more options in more situations during games.

Most power skating coaches teach arm swing based on what they see in sprinters, and on the surface it makes complete sense. videos.summary_source_text:
Nya Volvo V70 är på gång! Volvo står inför sin största modelloffensiv någonsin och som jag tidigare rapporterat lär det bland annat komma en mycket avancerad EX50 – en lite mindre systerbil till EX60.
För den Kinesiska marknaden har Volvo meddelat att man satsar på laddhybrider och information som jag fått säger att en av alla nya bilar för Kina blir en ny Volvo V70!
Kanske en EV70?!

Bilen ska bygga på Lynk & Co 07GT, som är en laddhybrid, som går ca 20 mil på el enligt den Kinesiska normen. Bilen är 4,8 meter lång.
Volvo har för övrigt tagit över ansvaret för försäljningen  av Lynk & Co i Europa, så de två varumärkena närmar sig varandra mer och mer.
Den XC70 som säljs i Kina, är också en laddhybrid, baserad på Lynk & Co 08.

Jag intervjuar min kinesiska Youtubekollega Jacky Wang, som har mycket bra blick över den Kinesiska marknaden, och han tycker att Volvo gör helt rätt som fokuserar på laddhybrider.
Vi diskuterar också andra tänkbara Volvomodeller, Europeiska premiumtillverkares chanser i Kina, prisstrategier och mycket mycket mer!

videos.summary_source_text:
How to Shallow Your Driver Without Forcing It If your driver swing gets steep or over the top, trying to manually “drop” the golf club usually isn’t the best fix. ⛳️

What you really need is a better reference for where the club should travel in the downswing.

COMMENT "BRICK ME" & I'll send over the link!

Watch the path of the driver in this drill.
Instead of the club working steeply over the top, the goal is to give it room to shallow in transition and approach the golf ball on a better swing plane.

Why does that matter?
A better driver swing path can make it easier to:
→ Stop cutting across the golf ball
→ Deliver the club more consistently
→ Create a more inside approach to impact
→ Build a repeatable driver swing without adding more swing thoughts

And this is an important distinction:
You’re not trying to place the golf club into a perfect position.
You’re training your body to recognize the space the club needs to move through.
That’s why using an external reference can be so helpful.
With the Blue Brick, the alignment stick gives you immediate feedback: instead of wondering whether your downswing is shallow enough, you have a physical constraint to work around.

The goal becomes simple:
Swing without crashing into the reference.

Do that repeatedly and you can start building the feel of a shallower driver swing rather than trying to memorize another technical position.
